# S57 — Settings About card: version, licence, source link and third-party notices

**Findings:** MainScreen.kt:455-461 ("Privacy-first defaults … in v1" header); no version or licence information anywhere in the app · **Size:** S · **Tree:** ui

**Not in this slice:** an in-app privacy policy (S20 publishes it), a licence-collection Gradle plugin (Google's oss-licenses plugin depends on Play services and is not allowed), and a crash reporter.

## Why

- There is no way to see the app version in the app, which bug reports need.
- The APK bundles Apache-2.0 libraries (AndroidX, Kotlin, kotlinx-coroutines). Showing their licence in the app is the usual way to meet the attribution expectations of Apache-2.0 §4.
- The Settings header says "…avoids account-based sync in v1", which is development copy, not user copy.

- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ui/SettingsScreen.kt`

## Implement

1. Replace the Settings header item (the "Privacy-first defaults" title and paragraph) with one line: "Your data stays on this device unless you export it." (string resource).
2. Add an "About" `SettingsCard` as the last item:
   - "Consecutor %1$s" with `BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME`.
   - "Free software under the Mozilla Public License 2.0."
   - A "Source code" `TextButton` that calls `context.startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse("https://github.com/squalor-xyz/consecutor")))` inside `try { … } catch (e: ActivityNotFoundException) { … }`, showing a snackbar "No app can open links." on failure. Opening a browser needs no permission and no `<queries>` entry.
   - An "Open-source licences" `TextButton` that opens an `AlertDialog` whose text is the content of `R.raw.third_party_notices` (read with `context.resources.openRawResource(...).bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }` inside `remember`), in a vertically scrollable `Column`, with a "Close" button.
3. `third_party_notices.txt`: run `./gradlew :app:dependencies --configuration releaseRuntimeClasspath` (after S46), and for each distinct `group:artifact` write one line `group:artifact — License name`, grouped by licence. Take each licence from the artifact's POM (`<licenses>`) or its project page; do not guess. After the list, include the full text of each licence that appears (Apache-2.0 is expected for AndroidX, Kotlin and kotlinx). Start the file with "Consecutor is licensed under MPL-2.0. It includes the following open-source components:".
4. All visible text goes through `stringResource` (S18's convention), except the notices file, which stays English.

- `./gradlew lintDebug assembleDebug` passes.
- Every runtime dependency is listed: `./gradlew -q :app:dependencies --configuration releaseRuntimeClasspath | rg -o '[a-z0-9.\-]+:[a-z0-9.\-]+(?=:)' | sort -u` and confirm each `group:artifact` appears in `third_party_notices.txt`.
- Manual: the About card shows the version from `app/build.gradle`, Source code opens the repository page in a browser, and the licences dialog scrolls to the end.
